summary: Red and falsification on the unchanged baseline: forbidding the global backfill failed the four history suites (33 failed / 10 passed), and disabling writer genesis left all 43 history tests green, proving they depended on backfill rather than the writer-only install. The fixture-timing rows were shown to rely on fixed microtask drains and clock polling. Lane A (gpt-6-sol) reproduced the disabled-genesis falsification (33 branch-dependent failures) and forced off/enabled runs.
